items.reason: Neither pattern exists: sast.yml triggers on push/pull_request/schedule (never pull_request_target), and every ${{ }} in agent-review.yml is bound in an env: block and read as a quoted shell variable — the only literal occurrences of 'pull_request_target' and of expressions near run: bodies are in the prose comments explaining why they are forbidden, and both rules are already enforced repo-wide and blocking by scripts/actions-pin.mjs (P2, P5, P7).

needs network: pinning the 25 actions/* refs requires resolving each tag through the GitHub API and the 3 node:24-alpine stages require a registry digest lookup; the tooling to do it in one pass already exists and is complete (npm run actions:pin rewrites the workflows AND flips STRICT/RATCHET in the same run), and this session has no shell or network, so there was nothing left to build and no way to run it.

lessons: systedo-case already encodes its workflow-security invariants as a blocking repo-local policy script (scripts/actions-pin.mjs, rules P1-P8, run in sast.yml and inside npm run check:ci) and documents each rule in SECURITY.md — check that script and the workflow's own comments before treating a dangerous-workflow finding as real, because those files quote the exact patterns they forbid in prose and that is what a text-matching scanner hits.

This repository's remaining action-pinning gap is a decision plus one networked command, not a build: scripts/actions-pin.mjs --update pins every ref and writes STRICT = true / RATCHET.pinned back into itself in the same pass, so an offline agent can neither close it nor usefully prepare it.

Ascent lanes in this worktree get no command execution at all (even `node script.mjs` is refused), so changes to blocking gate scripts are unverifiable here and should not be attempted — master ships on push, and an unverified edit to check:ci is a broken release.
